_why_not_applied: This role changes administrative access paths for the account's only human principal. It is submitted for adjudication rather than applied, consistent with the direction that policy work affecting administrative controls be separately governed.

_truthful_disposition.what_this_achieves: separation of operating CONTEXT and CREDENTIALS, not separation of human authority
_truthful_disposition.what_this_does_not_achieve: prevention against the management-account root/admin; the same human retains a break-glass administrative path
_truthful_disposition.operational_custodian: Jay Wang (or the legally appropriate named individual) — a real accountable person, not the adjudicator role and not the artifact producer

break_glass.constraint: use must be exceptional and observable
break_glass.observability: every listed destructive and control-plane call is covered by the mr002-custody-ecr-mutation and mr002-custody-control-plane EventBridge rules, which notify arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:219024422756:workbench-paper-alarms
break_glass.honest_limitation: the break-glass path is NOT technically prevented and cannot be in a management account; it is DETECTED, not blocked

open_decisions_for_adjudication: whether to apply this role at all, or to defer until a member-account migration
whether the everyday administrative identity should be narrowed once this role exists
the named operational custodian of record, distinct from adjudicator and producer
